display.title: Sponsor Message: Lagavina Kosher Cheese (Class Photo)
display.summary_short: The radio show's sponsor jingle: a class lines up for a photograph, and instead of 'cheese' everyone says 'Lagavina!', the kosher cheese supervised from milking time.
display.summary_long: A one-minute commercial from the sponsor of Uncle Yossi's Tzivos Hashem on the Air in the mid-1980s. A photographer lines up a class of children for their picture and tells them to say 'cheese', and the children answer 'Lagavina!' They describe Lagavina kosher cheese as the best cheese they ever ate: kosher supervised from the time the cows are milked, 100% natural with no additives or preservatives, in varieties like muenster, cheddar and mozzarella. The photographer gets hungry and everyone ends with the slogan 'Don't say cheese, say Lagavina.' The same spot ran in many episodes of the program during 1984-1985.

date.note: Inherits the air date of episode 155 (cf97f15688). Episode: First night of Chanukah 5745 ('you have probably lit your menorah by now', 'tonight and the rest of the eight days'); one week after ep 154.

quality.notes: A period commercial for the show's sponsor. ASR spells the brand several ways (Lagarina, Lagvina).
